headline: Sources: Man United turn to U.S. coach Pochettino with Carrick on the brink
description: United States coach Mauricio Pochettino is the favored candidate to replace Michael Carrick as Manchester United manager, sources have told ESPN.

headline: Think less, run more: The rise of man-marking in the Premier League
description: Premier League clubs are running faster, pressing harder and valuing athleticism more than ever. So what happens when everyone plays that way?

headline: Premier League overreactions: Brighton vs. Arsenal for title? Man United's resilience will save them?
description: Brighton continue to impress, but should Arsenal be worried? What to make of Man United's dramatic comeback? Let's judge some overreactions!

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Arsenal to offload three players, with Atlético Madrid keen
description: Atlético Madrid are one of the main clubs showing an interest in Arsenal midfielder Martín Zubimendi, while Viktor Gyökeres and Mikel Merino could also depart. Transfer Talk has the latest.

description: Manchester United are in the relegation zone and are looking to improve their defense in January. Transfer Talk has the latest.
